problemSigns.sign: Loading Dock Door Stuck Open or Closed
problemSigns.detail: A commercial loading dock door that will not move up or down stops operations. This can expose inventory or prevent shipments.

problemSigns.sign: Rolling Steel Curtain Off Its Guides
problemSigns.detail: When a rolling steel curtain disengages from its side tracks, it can jam. This prevents proper security or access.
Continuous use or excessive strain can cause commercial garage door operator motors to fail. The door will not open or close automatically.

problemSigns.sign: High-Cycle Springs at End of Life
problemSigns.detail: Commercial doors use specialized high-cycle springs. These springs wear out after tens of thousands of cycles. A broken spring prevents door movement.
